data.narrative:
Bedrock Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Boris Sofman, Kevin Peterson, Ajay Gummalla, and Tom Eliaz. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private firms and one public entity operating in robotics and manufacturing, including stage-matched peers such as Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), and adjacent-stage companies including Hadrian, Agile Robots, and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B–$1.6B Series C).

Two triangulation methods apply to this valuation. The Stage-Progression method applies a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to Bedrock's last post-money valuation of $1.8B, implying $3.3B. The Peer-Median method benchmarks against five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, yielding a median valuation of $1.6B with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. These divergent results reflect uncertainty in both forward-looking growth expectations and peer precedent weighting.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $3.8B, with a median estimate of $2.5B. The current $1.75B post-money sits in the lower-middle of this range. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-progression multiple for this cohort and the relative comparability of peers across Series B and Series C, given heterogeneous growth trajectories in robotics.
